title: rui1022: Sidecar mods + remote pages (default, recommended)
description: Everything in sfx1021, plus the remote pages: hold TRK, press YES for the SIDECAR and SYSTEM status pages and the voice pages, in the Rytm's own font, on Sidecar Mini and Sidecar. The page catches only the keys and knobs it uses: PLAY / STOP / RECORD always reach the Rytm, pads, mutes, FILL and tap tempo work as usual. Needs a 1021 Sidecar; an older Pi kernel shows the pages without text.
